title: Dyladmar pulls away to Harrington Raceway victory - NewsBreak
text:
6 hours ago
HARRINGTON - Dreamville Stable's Dyladmar ($35, Russell Foster) was a 1:55.1 winner in the $18,000 Open Trot on Wednesday at Harrington Raceway.
The 5-year-old Muscle Hill gelding went right to the front and never looked back in a open length win over Speed Away, who was the race favorite and had traffic issues, was second while Mickey Muscles was third.
It was the sixth win of the season for Dyladmar, who is trained by Edwin Gannon Jr.
Howard Taylor’s trotter Bourbon Buzz ($2.10, Corey Callahan) won his third straight race in a decisive 1:57 romp for trainer Tom Shay.
Jim Morand, Corey Callahan and Art Stafford Jr. each had driving doubles.
Live racing will continue on a Monday through Wednesday schedule (post time 4:30 p.m.).
